login.title: Injira muri Soko.
login.description: Injira ukoresheje konti yawe ya MarketAI. Konti y’ubuyobozi: admin@soko.com / Admin@123

forgotPassword.title: Wibagiwe ijambo ry’ibanga?
forgotPassword.description: Andika imeyili yawe maze tuzohereza umurongo wo guhindura ijambo ry’ibanga.
forgotPassword.successDescription: Niba hari konti ifite iyo imeyili, umurongo wo guhindura ijambo ry’ibanga woherejwe. Reba ububiko bw’imeyili n’ubwa spam.

register.title: Iyandikishe kuri Soko.
register.description: Fungura konti yawe, hanyuma wemeze imeyili uhitemo inshingano mbere yo kwinjira.
register.successMessage: {{message}} Ibikurikira: fungura umurongo woherejwe kuri {{email}} maze wandike kode y’inyuguti 6.

claimRole.title: Hitamo inshingano yawe
claimRole.description: Rangiza igenamiterere kuri {{email}}. Hitamo uko uzakoresha Soko.
claimRole.successMessage: {{message}} Ubu ushobora kwinjira nk’umukoresha w’inshingano ya {{role}}.

BUYER.title: Umuguzi
BUYER.description: Shaka amagi kandi ucunge amasezerano yo kugura.

SUPPLIER.title: Utanga ibicuruzwa
SUPPLIER.description: Shyira ibicuruzwa ku isoko kandi usubize amatangazo yo kugurisha.

AGGREGATOR.title: Ukusanya umusaruro
AGGREGATOR.description: Gura no kugurisha ukoresheje ahantu hamwe.

verifyEmail.title: Emeza imeyili yawe
verifyEmail.description: Andika kode y’inyuguti 6 woherejwe kuri imeyili kugira ngo wemeze konti yawe.
verifyEmail.invalidCode: Andika kode y’inyuguti 6 yo kuri imeyili yawe.

resetPassword.title: Hitamo ijambo ry’ibanga rishya
resetPassword.description: Andika ijambo ry’ibanga rishya kuri konti yawe ya MarketAI.
